message: I'll change the title of slide 3 to 'What HTML slides are'.

slides.purpose: Introduce HTML slides as the modern alternative
slides.content_brief: Title the slide 'What HTML slides are'. Define what HTML slides are — presentations built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript rendered in a browser. Name leading frameworks (Reveal.js, Slidev, Marp, Impress.js). Feature the callout stat that 98% of devices have a modern browser, making every device a presentation engine
slides.assumes: The audience understands that websites are built with HTML/CSS/JS
slides.hands_off: HTML slides turn the browser into a full-featured, universally available presentation platform
